title: Void Manta
text: Void Mantas do not proactively attack players and retaliate in melee for 10 true damage.

Void Mantas fly and swim. They prefer reachable waterlike pools within 16 blocks with at least a continuous 3x3x2 volume, and avoid Decayed Timeflow. Without suitable water, they wander roughly 2 to 6 blocks above the ground. They remain level while swimming.

Holding a Spatial Crystal in either hand attracts nearby mantas without interrupting riding, staying or retaliation. Each crystal has a one-in-three chance to tame a manta. Its owner can ride without a saddle; sneak-use toggles following or staying. Riding grants water breathing and starflow protection. Look up or down while moving to change altitude, jump to rise, and sneak to dismount.

Void Mantas are space creatures, protected against spatial biome hazards and starflow, but not against time hazards. They evade physical attacks, including melee attacks and arrows, but cannot evade spell projectiles.
A Void Manta drops one Unstable Spacetime Aggregate and 3–5 Spatial Crystals.
